name: The Redvein Quarry
history: Karrathi families have long gathered red and ochre stone from this hillside for pigments and ceremonial objects. Cadorian prospectors recently obtained a concession to quarry the spur for building stone. While opening a new face, workers exposed a dark seam that exudes a red liquid when struck.
current_state: Quarrying has been suspended at the disputed face after Karrathi wardens confronted the workers. The concession holder insists the seam represents a valuable discovery; the wardens maintain that the hillside is subject to an older customary agreement. Neither party has established what the liquid is.
inhabitants: A small quarry crew, its foreman, and intermittently visiting Karrathi wardens; no established monstrous inhabitants.
danger_level: Low under ordinary conditions; moderate if the dispute turns violent or excavation exposes a hazard.
discovery: A rocky spur near the margins of Karrathi territory. The Claims Hall and quarry workers can provide directions. Karrathi wardens know the older approaches to the hillside.
site_type: quarry | Inhabited locations; Natural wonders | Active stone quarry; disputed mineral deposit
points_of_interest:
Stepped quarry faces; tool shed and workers’ shelter; exposed dark seam; old pigment-gathering pits; weathered Karrathi boundary markers; a narrow fissure behind the new face.

Unresolved elements: Validity and extent of the older agreement; nature and value of the liquid; significance of the seam to Karrathi traditions; what lies behind the fissure.
